items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: He was known by the name of Country and he worked for a judge there, Judge Gershon.

ctx.x: Oh goodness, I've forgotten the street. I think 18th and Vine. This was where they had a floor show and everything but after the floor show everybody would jam I guess from 1 o'clock till maybe 12 the next day. We had a wonderful friend that used to help out the musicians. He and Piney Brown were really friends of the musicians. He was known by the name of Country and he worked for a judge there, Judge Gershon. We used to laugh about the two of them together. Country was the chauffeur and Judge Gershon's…
